notes.title: DCU Patch 0.5.9 - Custom Radio, Graphic Settings and Gamepad Support
notes.content:
Greetings from HSG®

Introducing DCU Patch 0.5.9 with Custom Radio and its functionalities and optimized Gamepad support for Twin Stick Controllers with and without sensitivity Back Trigger Buttons. A key map is added in the Keybinds settings screen and more presets will be added later as a well as user defined key binding option. Some General Graphic settings are added in the settings for now and the other will be added later on. Also in general fixes and improvements are made.

List with things that done in this patch:


Added Radio with functionalities like a real radio.

Added Gamepad Preset (User can still modify their Gamepad keybinds through steam).

Added basic Graphics Settings.

Direct X Level Selection on Steam when launching the game.

Improved Sound Mastering (Music).

Added Volume Sliders in-game options menu (Overall, SFX and Music).

Added Terrain Physics and Sound (More optimization later).

Minor Bug Fixes.


New on the upcoming patches:


Realistic car engine sounds.

Customizable License Plate (User Type Input)

Night mode

New places

New Cars

User Keybinds (Keyboard and Gamepad)

Controller Presets

More detailed Main Menu Options

More Radio Songs

Optimized Top-Down Camera

Performance Improvements



Thumbs up and take care!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43490528/16339827e64731b7afc4c5507144178fc5ef4970.jpg"]

For better performance on decent PCs you can force the game to run in DX11 by adding the command in the Command Line Arguments
